title: Ferroelectric capacitor logarithmic aging
description: Estimate capacitance loss from a measured one-hour post-deaging value and a calibrated percent-per-decade aging rate.
formula: d = log10(t/3600 s); loss = A d/100; C(t) = C_1h (1-loss)
assumptions: Class II/III ferroelectric ceramic with an approximately constant logarithmic aging rate over the supplied interval.
Time is seconds since the last heating above the material Curie temperature; reference capacitance is measured at exactly one hour.
No subsequent deaging, temperature change or DC-bias change. Aging rate is percent of the one-hour reference per decade, not compounded percent of the preceding decade.
Use part-specific characterized aging data. This is not a lifetime or reliability prediction.

references.title: KYOCERA AVX / American Technical Ceramics, Dielectric Aging Phenomena, Calculating Aging Rate

constraints.message: The logarithmic fit must retain positive capacitance.
